threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it 'The Tube' instead of 'the underground' and look confused when the bus takes the scenic route.
Spotted a guy on the 333 last night trying to feed pigeons his chips. They just stared, probably judging his life choices.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a group of kids playing soccer in the middle of the street while a bus honked to get by. Just another Saturday afternoon here.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain can you find a bar that serves beer on tap from a bicycle. It's a mobile tap experience that really captures the DIY spirit.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: A true local knows the BART delays aren't just inconvenient; they’re a way of life. Tourist types just sigh and pull out their phones.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Just saw a guy juggle while waiting for the 19. Only in San Francisco would that be a Tuesday commute.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they can just grab a café con leche anywhere, but the secret spots are small and often don’t have signage. They miss the real charm.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They still look baffled by the ticket machines at the metro, fumbling with coins like it's a foreign artifact.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think the 243 bus is reliable. Only locals know it’s a suggestion, not a timetable.
Last night on the 59, a guy started singing opera between stops. The whole bus just went quiet, then joined in for the chorus. Classic Brixton vibes.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I heard three different languages yelling at the BVG for being late, I knew Neukölln was home. Only here can chaos sound so harmonious.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you grab a currywurst at 3 AM while watching a street artist turn the U-Bahn station into a gallery. Pure Berlin vibe.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell who’s local by how they navigate BART mishaps. Tourists panic, locals just roll their eyes and pull up the next bus arrival time.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a guy juggling on the bus while a couple near the back argued about rent. Classic SF, where chaos and talent ride together.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they can stroll into any bar and get 'tapas'. In Gràcia, it’s all about the platillos—tiny dishes more local folks opt for, and they’re often hidden away.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell they're new by how they linger at the flower stalls, fumbling with their Catalan. Only locals know to save their euros for the markets.
